title: Add a truncate(str, max) helper
body:
Add `truncate(str, max)` to `src/strings.js` and export it.

If `str.length <= max`, return `str` unchanged. Otherwise return the first `max - 3` characters followed by `"..."`, so the result is exactly `max` characters long. Example: `truncate("Hello world", 8)` returns `"Hello..."`.
